messages:
Sophie: Quick sync: we need to pick inference performance bets for next sprint. Customer asks and roadmap need alignment. I'm thinking we run an impact-vs-effort quick map and choose two MVPs.
AJ: Agree on impact/effort map. Also let's keep scope tight; dedicated customers keep asking about p95.
Kevin: From infra: batching + session affinity gives largest cost wins. Tail latency fixes need kernel + scheduling work and may take longer.
Maria: Can we define clear launch gates? For MVP A (batching): measurable 15% cost reduction at 95% traffic; no more than 8% p95 regression. For MVP B (tail latency): p95 <130ms for short chats and no increased error rate.
Sophie: Proposal: do batching-first MVP (fast, lower risk), and run a parallel small-lab latency experiment. Use a lightweight prioritization sheet: reach/impact/confidence/effort as categorical (S/M/L) to speed decisions.
Oliver: Sales flagged two deals that will churn if we can't commit to p95 SLAs. If we lose them impact is high.
Maia: I'll surface the exact SLA wording and test prompts.
engbot: perf-bot: perf-run queued 1801240800. Tag runs with `perf/sprint-13`.
Kevin: Canary plan draft:
```
canary_percent: 3
duration: 45m
metrics: p95_latency, error_rate, cost_per_k_tokens
stop_condition: p95 > baseline * 1.06 OR error_rate > baseline + 0.8%
```
AJ: +1. Also add scenario labels: cold_start, cached_prefix, long_seq.
Maria: We'll add eval prompts to detect hallucination/regression with batching/quant.
Sophie: Actions: (1) AJ + Kevin draft sprint canvas and link it here by EOD; (2) Maia collates SLAs & prompts; (3) Infra run perf cluster and post results; (4) Product drafts customer comms and canary runbook.
Oliver: Please include a fallback policy: if canary fails auto-route to older model variant.
deploybot: deploy-bot: perf cluster live at 1801240800; artifacts to /logs/perf/sprint-13
Sophie: If nobody objects, we'll proceed with batching-first sequencing and keep latency experiments constrained. Call out any serious blockers now.
Oliver: Noted, but Sales needs explicit risks called out in the customer comms.
AJ: I'll add a short impact/effort sheet and ping the channel.
